It's so far back in the past, that there is no reason to fear that any story we tell could interfere with core continuity.|Christian Gossett, ''Tales of the Jedi'' artist|<ref name="ChrisGos, TFN interview" />}}
'''''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi''''', abbreviated as '''''TotJ''''', is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series covering eight story arcs, all published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. Set during the [[Old Republic era]], six of the eight ''Tales of the Jedi'' story arcs take place during the [[Time/Legends|time]] surrounding the events known collectively as the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict instigated by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces aimed at [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] domination. These six story arcs nominally focus on the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]; his love interest, [[Nomi Sunrider]]; and a cast of supporting characters, including Ulic's own brother, [[Cay Qel-Droma]]. Likewise, first appearing in [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] went on to become a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and wage war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. The remaining two story arcs, [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']], occur in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and revolve around [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and his schemes to [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invade]] Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] through his manipulation of the [[Daragon family|Daragon]] siblings, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon|Jori]].

The first two story arcs, entitled [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon|''Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon'']] and [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Saga of Nomi Sunrider|''The Saga of Nomi Sunrider'']], were written by veteran ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Tom Veitch]]. Together they formed the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (miniseries)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] miniseries, which eventually became known as ''Knights of the Old Republic''. Veitch went on to write the next story arc, [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising|''The Freedon Nadd Uprising'']], and co-authored the fourth story arc, ''Dark Lords of the Sith'', with fellow author [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. With the successful completion of ''Dark Lords of the Sith'', Anderson continued the ''Tales of the Jedi'' series as the sole storyline writer, with Veitch opting not to continue writing for the series. Anderson went on to write the final two story arcs, involving main protagonist Ulic Qel-Droma, completing [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War|''The Sith War'']] in the spring of [[1996]] and [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption|''Redemption'']] in the fall of [[1998]]. In the years between the writing of ''The Sith War'' and ''Redemption'', Anderson wrote two more story arcs, [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']], both taking place [[5000 BBY/Legends|1,000 years before]] the other ''Tales of the Jedi'' stories and introducing readers to the events surrounding the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

The ''Tales of the Jedi'' saga also produced several non-comic productions, such as the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', a sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', and two different audio dramas based on various ''Tales of the Jedi'' comics. ''Tales of the Jedi'' was the inspiration for the popular [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series, and a [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|bridging comic]] has been published by Dark Horse Comics.
